revenue.source: NVDA 10-K FY2026 acc. 0001045810-26-000021, us-gaap:Revenues, USD millions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: decelerating from FY2026 growth of 65.5% (215,938 vs 130,497) as the base gets large; fades toward mature levels by FY2031.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: slightly below FY2026 actual 60.4% (130,387/215,938) to allow for competition and pricing normalization.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~15.1% (1 - 120,067/141,450 pretax, acc. 0001045810-26-000021), rounded up modestly for rising global minimum taxes.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta 1.50 (Damodaran Semiconductor US unlevered cash-corrected 1.5046, relevered at ~0% D/E; debt 8.5B vs large equity) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~11.6% cost of equity; debt weight negligible, so WACC ~11.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 8,468 - cash 10,605 - short-term investments (reported null/not found for FY2026), acc. 0001045810-26-000021. Caveat: marketable securities not captured, so true net cash is likely larger; reviewer should check the balance sheet.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 24,514,000,000 (us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding), acc. 0001045810-26-000021, in millions
